name: Lumiracoxib

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Canada and 2 other countries, first in 2007 — for liver harm

similar.name: Diclofenac
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for nerve and brain harm, stomach and gut problems and heart harm

similar.name: Meclofenamic Acid
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for stomach and gut problems, heart harm and nerve and brain harm

examples.title: Safety Study of Renal Function in Patients With Chronic Kidney Failure Taking Lumiracoxib or Diclofenac for Arthralgia
examples.why: Interim analysis shows harma to one of the study arms.

summary: Lumiracoxib was pulled from the market in Canada and two other countries starting in 2007 because of liver harm, and an interim check in a safety study on patients with kidney failure showed harm to one of the trial groups [3][7]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high risk score of 81 for liver issues and a low risk score of 18 for heart issues [M]. Related drugs like Diclofenac and Meclofenamic Acid carry United States boxed warnings for heart harm, digestive system damage, and nerve toxicity, which is damage to the brain or nervous system [4][5].
